name: Google Cloud Professional Agentic Architect

fee.note: Announced retail price, not a verified available appointment. The $120 beta registration closed on 30 September 2026.

exam.format: Official FAQ announces GA in mid-November 2026, with a two-hour proctored exam plus required separate hands-on labs. Passing the exam alone does not earn the credential.

scope: Designing agentic systems on Google Cloud.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.

domains.name: Using coding agents for application development

domains_note: Weights from the Google Cloud Professional Agentic Architect exam guide linked from the certification page, read 2026-11-03. Google marks each weight as approximate (~) and they cover the multiple-choice exam only; the required hands-on labs are separate and unweighted. The page still describes the beta; GA opens mid-November 2026, so recheck the guide at GA.
